items.heading: A Break for Marriage, Childcare,
items.text: A break for marriage, childcare, or family responsibility is not a gap that needs explaining away, it needs an actual plan. That plan is a rebuilt, high-value skill portfolio and a positioning story that gets you back into stronger roles, not just any role, and moves you toward earlier financial freedom instead of a lower rung than before. If a career break and return to work is your main decision right now, the dedicated career guidance for women returning to work goes deeper on the gap, the skill refresh, and the confidence rebuild specifically.
